summary_1line: Rama, urged by Vishwamitra to uphold dharma, battles the demoness Taraka and ultimately slays her with an arrow.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands in the forest drawing his bow as the gigantic demoness Taraka charges through a cloud of dust with raised arms.
Taraka hurls a magical rain of rocks from the sky while Rama and Lakshmana defend themselves amid the storm of stones.
Rama releases a sound-seeking arrow that pierces Taraka’s heart as she roars and collapses in the forest while the gods watch from the heavens.
